description: One email needs two approvals: an agent-written 'Approve sending this email? Approve and send / Cancel' card, then a second 'Review before GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL' card with Allow once / Deny.
actual: Two sequential cards for the same send (step-3 then step-4).
suggested_fix: Drop the model-authored confirmation when the tool-approval card follows.

description: The two approval cards differ in style, and the second shows the raw tool name and a JSON block. First card: two identical stacked outline buttons with no primary. Second card: light primary 'Allow once', 'Deny' and 'tool: GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL arguments: {...}'.
expected: One card style; readable fields (To, Subject, Body).
actual: Mixed card styles; internal tool id and JSON shown to a founder.
suggested_fix: Render writes as a mail card (as the Carta mail card does) and hide tool ids.

description: 'Denied' is shown in the same green as 'Allowed once' and 'Answered'.
expected: Denial reads neutral or distinct from approval.
suggested_fix: Use a neutral/muted color for denied.

description: After I denied the second send (test2@), the agent produced a new approval card to send the first email (test@, 'Hello') again, which had already been sent. Possibly demo-model behavior, not verified with a real model.
expected: After Deny the agent stops and says nothing was sent.
actual: A fresh Allow once / Deny card for an earlier message appeared (step-7); I denied it too.
suggested_fix: Confirm the agent does not retry a denied write; add a test.

description: The switch hint 'Off: the agent only reads. On: it can also make changes...' stays the same in both states.
expected: Show the sentence for the current state only.
suggested_fix: Switch the hint text with the state.
